subject.title: [Bug]: WeChat channel session permanently corrupted after ingesting binary file attachments

question: Should this issue remain open as distinct WeChat binary-ingestion evidence while the overlapping core/session and placeholder fixes land, or should maintainers fold it into an existing canonical tracker now?
rationale: The report spans external WeChat plugin media ingestion, core reply-session state, stable package parity, and provider tool-result projection; automation cannot safely choose the ownership boundary or closure target without maintainer scoping.

options.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open until the overlapping fixes are merged/released and the WeChat binary-attachment workflow is checked against the external plugin path.

options.title: Fold Into Placeholder Tracker
options.body: Close or retarget this to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99881 if maintainers decide the WeChat trigger is only another manifestation of the same placeholder bug.

options.title: Route To Plugin Owner
options.body: Move the remaining work to the external WeChat plugin if maintainers confirm core preserves text/session invariants and only plugin media normalization remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the overlapping fixes are merged/released and the WeChat binary-attachment workflow is checked against the external plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest history signal across the current AI provider package boundary and WeChat external-plugin documentation, while session specialists can support implementation details.
